business_motivation: Competitive Edge: Identifying 'white space' in the patent landscape to guide R&D investment.
workflow_friction: Abstracts are often written to be intentionally broad or vague, making it hard to pinpoint the true 'novelty' without comparative analysis.

potential_tasks.description: Analyze abstracts across a specific CPC label to generate a summary of 'saturated' technical claims versus emerging trends.
Translate highly specialized Physics (Label 6) abstracts into layperson business terms to evaluate cross-industry licensing potential.

business_motivation: Factual Precision: Minimizing the 'Misclassification Rate' that leads to costly legal challenges during the examination phase.
workflow_friction: The dataset contains shorthand and jargon that may lead to 'label drift' where the abstract content technically straddles two CPC sections.

potential_tasks.description: Critically evaluate if the technical summary in the 'text' field logically justifies the assigned CPC section code.
Identify abstracts that contain keywords from multiple domains (e.g., Medical + Electricity) and propose a primary vs. secondary classification rationale.

business_motivation: Revenue Generation: Maximizing the speed and volume of successful technology transfers to commercial partners.
workflow_friction: Extracting 'use-case' scenarios from abstract text that is formatted for legal protection rather than commercial appeal.

potential_tasks.description: Transform technical abstracts into bulleted lists of 'Commercial Advantages' and 'Problem-Solution' pairs.
Verify that AI-generated summaries of complex 'Human Necessities' (Label 0) patents do not invent functional capabilities not present in the text.

business_motivation: Efficiency: Reducing the 'Time-per-Disposal' metric while maintaining high examination rigor.
workflow_friction: Dense, repetitive sentence structures in abstracts make manual feature extraction exhausting and prone to human error.

potential_tasks.description: Extract the primary independent claim elements from the abstract to facilitate faster prior-art matching.
Resolve ambiguous acronyms and technical terms within the abstract based on the specific CPC section context (e.g., 'Cell' in Biology vs. Electricity).

business_motivation: Market Awareness: Ensuring the product roadmap accounts for competitors' newly patented technical capabilities.
workflow_friction: Abstracts focus on 'how' it works (technical) whereas the persona needs to know 'what' it solves (market-facing).

potential_tasks.description: Re-write patent abstracts into a 'Product Release Note' format for internal stakeholder briefing.
Given a set of competitor abstracts, identify potential 'design-around' strategies to avoid infringement without requiring legal counsel.

business_motivation: Transparency: Ensuring that AI models trained on patent data are auditable and do not exhibit systematic bias against certain technical sections.
workflow_friction: The lack of demographic or metadata context in the raw dataset makes it difficult to assess 'inventor diversity' or 'geographic bias'.

potential_tasks.description: Review model outputs for specific CPC sections to ensure technical summaries do not introduce gendered or exclusionary language.
Create a 'Rationale Document' that explains why specific technical keywords in an abstract triggered a high-confidence classification.

business_motivation: Knowledge Retrieval: Ensuring that 52,000+ records are discoverable by internal scientists via intuitive search.
workflow_friction: The CPC labels are too broad (only 9 categories) for nuanced internal search; users need more granular 'tags'.

potential_tasks.description: Automatically generate 3-5 granular 'micro-tags' for each abstract that go beyond the 9 high-level CPC sections.
Convert abstracts written in 'Patent-ese' into standard scientific abstract formats to improve internal database readability.

business_motivation: Cost-Effectiveness: Optimizing the use of LLMs for patent processing by balancing performance and token expenditure.
workflow_friction: Longer abstracts increase token costs significantly; there is a need to determine the 'minimum viable text' for accurate processing.

potential_tasks.description: Determine if a highly compressed version of the abstract (under 50 tokens) retains enough technical density for correct classification.
Systematically compare AI summaries of 'Electricity' (Label 7) patents against the raw text to identify common technical 'hallucination' patterns.
